name: nihul-mosad-safety-net
description: רשת ביטחון: סביבת ניסוי ובדיקות אוטומטיות למערכת ניהול המוסד

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/smoke.test.mjs tests/flows.test.mjs tests/save-safety.test.mjs tests/student-summary.test.mjs tests/summary-server.test.mjs tests/smart-card.test.mjs tests/mapping.test.mjs tests/readability.test.mjs tests/sidebar.test.mjs tests/dashboard.test.mjs
scripts.test:rules: cp ../firestore.rules firestore.rules.copy && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-nihul --only firestore "node --test tests/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.emulator: cp ../firestore.rules firestore.rules.copy && firebase emulators:start --project demo-nihul --only auth,firestore
scripts.serve: npm run build && npx --yes http-server out -p 5050 -a 127.0.0.1 -c-1
scripts.test:emulator: npm run build && cp ../firestore.rules firestore.rules.copy && firebase emulators:exec --project demo-nihul --only auth,firestore "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/emulator.test.mjs"
